website.note: Confirms BIM-IOL System lead candidate in two Phase 3 trials; BIM-DRS preclinical (FIH planned 2026, excluded as not yet clinical).

pipeline.modality: Drug-device combination (non-bioerodible drug pads attached to intraocular lens)
pipeline.target: Prostaglandin F2-alpha receptor (bimatoprost prostaglandin analogue) for sustained intraocular pressure (IOP) reduction

indications.indication: Reduction of IOP in patients with open-angle glaucoma (OAG) or ocular hypertension (OHT) undergoing cataract surgery
indications.trial_name: Rhine (NCT07218783) and Rhone (NCT07218796) — pivotal Phase 3 program
indications.trial_design: Prospective, multicenter, randomized, double-masked, controlled trials evaluating BIM-IOL System (Bimatoprost Implant System + SpyGlass IOL) versus timolol maleate ophthalmic solution 0.5% plus a commercial IOL, in OAG / OHT cataract-surgery patients
indications.trial_status: Recruiting (Rhine started 2025-10-15; Rhone started 2025-10-28; primary completion 2029-03 / 2029-05)
key_milestones: Phase 3 Rhine first patient dosed Q4 2025
Phase 3 Rhone first patient dosed Q4 2025

indications.indication: OAG / OHT with concomitant cataract — Phase 1/2 dose-ranging (high vs low dose)
indications.trial_design: Prospective, multicenter, randomized, double-masked, controlled trial of BIM-IOL System (high dose and low dose) versus timolol maleate 0.5% plus commercial monofocal IOL in patients with OAG/OHT and concomitant cataract; conducted in US, New Zealand and Asia
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (started 2023-10-13; primary completion 2025-01-31; long-term follow-up ongoing — 12-month safety/efficacy reported)
key_milestones: 12-month safety and efficacy data reported supporting Phase 3 progression

commercial_product.note: No approved/marketed products. SpyGlass Pharma is a clinical-stage ophthalmic drug-device company.

excluded_preclinical.reason: Preclinical / animal studies; first-in-human trial planned for 2026 but not yet initiated.

excluded_preclinical.asset: SpyGlass Platform feasibility programs (AMD, chronic uveitis, postoperative eye care)

summary_counts.note: BIM-IOL System counted once at highest phase (P3); same asset also has an ongoing Phase 1/2 dose-ranging study reported as a separate indication entry.
